scope: Local source QC and golden regression, not platform approval or a fresh Oracle
status: Prepared for platform review; public-network policy exceptions disclosed
limitations: Platform checker implementations are not supplied; workbook descriptions cannot be executed as those scripts.
User-requested public networking differs from the workbook's offline/allowlist text.
External-judge output and subjective quality ratings require a new platform run; no Oracle 1.0 promise.

Reference and starter hashes match coverage
Exact authoritative seed copy and hash
Globally unique ballot and choice ids
Distinct mutation probes not already seeded

render: browser, gate, injection defense and independent checks

quality_review.rubric: The prompt reads like a real person asking for an app, not a spec sheet, checklist, or build recipe.
quality_review.evidence: instruction.md is a short product request; implementation details are in referenced brief files.

quality_review.rubric: Keeps an authentic human voice (casual/terse is good); not robotic, over-polished, or LLM-generated prose.
quality_review.evidence: Original product voice retained. Only the development-network clarification was added.

quality_review.rubric: No real spelling errors and nothing pasted in by mistake (author notes, TODOs, stray paths, contradictions).
quality_review.evidence: Reviewed the brief and dimension prompts for wrong-task residue and contradictory language.

quality_review.rubric: Everything the judges grade is asked for, and the runtime contract (path, start command, port, storage, seed, accounts, no-network) is stated.
quality_review.evidence: runtime.md states server.js, Node, port, host, health, SQLite path, assets and seed; accounts are in overview.md.

quality_review.rubric: The prompt never names the judge, rubric, dimensions, weights, test paths, or grader sentinels.
quality_review.evidence: Agent brief does not expose tests, scoring weights or grader probes.

quality_review.rubric: One reasonable reading, and every capability is reachable from the seed + runtime with no network. Reports every ambiguity/unreachable item.
quality_review.evidence: Seed supplies all roles and lifecycle states; runtime is preinstalled. Revision/idempotency and privacy semantics are stated.

quality_review.rubric: Real build work is required; a stub or trivial tweak can't earn the reward.
quality_review.evidence: App must implement durable private voting and real server authority, not just render supplied data.

quality_review.rubric: Name, directory slug, description, keywords, and metadata all describe THIS task and agree.
quality_review.evidence: common-ground-ballot-v2 slug, package and 2.0.0 labels agree; the display brand is Common Ground. User explicitly requested a separate v2 while preserving the original task.

quality_review.rubric: Agent image is no-network with sane CPU/memory, no secret literals, and nothing that secretly needs an install.
quality_review.evidence: User explicitly requires public agent networking. This differs from this workbook row's no-network wording.

quality_review.rubric: Verifier runs separately on a pinned image + allowlist, with the judge model and API key fully wired.
quality_review.evidence: Separate pinned verifier and provider wiring checked; public verifier networking is an explicit exception to workbook allowlist wording.

quality_review.rubric: Agent, verifier, liveness, and judge timeouts are long enough and nest properly (inner < outer, sum of judges < verifier).
quality_review.evidence: Judge timeout sum 3420s < inner 4500s < verifier 4800s; readiness and cleanup are bounded.

quality_review.rubric: [environment].docker_image isn't set while the agent Dockerfile still has active build steps (which would skip it entirely).
quality_review.evidence: No docker_image override bypasses either Dockerfile.

quality_review.rubric: Any shipped inputs exist at the expected path and match what the prompt, solution, and judges assume (or N/A if none needed).
quality_review.evidence: Seed, starter, brief and verifier asset references checked against packaged files.

quality_review.rubric: Shipped data is self-consistent, synthetic (no real PII), and free of orphan references or injection payloads.
quality_review.evidence: Unique synthetic users, memberships, ballot/choice ownership and seeded vote totals validated.

quality_review.rubric: Agent image is pinned, pre-installs every runtime dependency (no run-time install), and stages the assets.
quality_review.evidence: Agent image build and native runtime/HTTPS preflight passed; certificates now asserted during build.

quality_review.rubric: The agent's world has the inputs and the ask, but no finished copy of the deliverable.
quality_review.evidence: Agent image has only requirements, seed and minimal starter. Tests and golden solution remain separate.

quality_review.rubric: The reference plausibly implements every feature/screen the instruction asks for.
quality_review.evidence: Golden workflows cover the six views, roles, voting methods, privacy, roster, audit and persistence.

quality_review.rubric: The reference plausibly satisfies every criterion the judges score, so the oracle can score high.
quality_review.evidence: Local browser groups pass, including the added mobile and restart checks. A fresh full Oracle is not yet available.

quality_review.rubric: solve.sh installs to the expected paths and the reference runs under the stated contract with no network / no run-time install.
quality_review.evidence: Golden solve.sh provisions the documented files; local app tests run without network or package installation.

quality_review.rubric: The reference is a committed, static baseline - not regenerated, fetched, or nondeterministic on any pinned value.
quality_review.evidence: Reference is static source with hashes; random opaque ids/tokens and timestamps are not exact pinned outputs. No fetch/regeneration.

quality_review.rubric: test.sh launches the app safely, gates on liveness, and writes a reward on every code path (including failures).
quality_review.evidence: Nine explicit local test-double cases cover launch failure, HTTP 500, delayed boot and score validation/composition; not Oracle scoring.

quality_review.rubric: The verifier Dockerfile ships a pinned browser, Playwright, judge CLI, rewardkit, and the runtime to start the app.
quality_review.evidence: Verifier image built; RewardKit discovery, Codex CLI, browser launch and native SQLite load passed.

quality_review.rubric: Every launch assumption in test.sh (probe URL, env vars, paths, seed, deps, same-origin) was told to the agent. Signature check of this format.
quality_review.evidence: No manifest-only path or file-extension assumptions; runner uses the exact instructed runtime contract.

quality_review.rubric: reward.toml and every judge.toml are structurally complete: pinned judge, browser MCP server, well-typed criteria with weights, valid aggregate.
quality_review.evidence: TOML parsed and RewardKit discovered 2/2/19/5 criteria; gates and weight composition tested.

quality_review.rubric: Every dimension prompt sends the judge into the live app via the browser tool - not scoring from source, memory, or first paint.
quality_review.evidence: All dimension prompts require Playwright live interaction and observed requests, not code-as-proof.

quality_review.rubric: Every requirement the prompt states maps to at least one criterion (nothing asked-for goes ungraded). Reports every gap.
quality_review.evidence: Requirement map updated. Draft validation/context, current logout, changing eligibility and real restart now have explicit probes.

quality_review.rubric: No criterion enforces something the prompt/professional default never required (no false-fail on correct apps). Reports every instance.
quality_review.evidence: Removed fixed JSON-key, visible receipt-widget and mandatory single-choice-percentage assumptions. Forgery checks test unauthorized impersonation.

quality_review.rubric: No two criteria grade the same thing twice, subsume each other, or demand incompatible products.
quality_review.evidence: Privacy and pre-publication count checks reconciled. Distinct retry/mismatch/duplicate operations retain separate evidence; shared final totals are corroboration.

quality_review.rubric: Every dimension carries the browser gate that hard-zeros blank/static-shell/cross-origin apps (plus auth/backing checks when relevant).
quality_review.evidence: Identical authenticated-backend browser gate appears in all four prompts. Public-control wording no longer waives the gate.

quality_review.rubric: Any 'rejects / hides / absent' check is paired with the matching success case, so a totally broken app can't earn it.
quality_review.evidence: Rejections have valid login/draft/vote/lifecycle controls. Ordinary logout also proves another valid session survives.

quality_review.rubric: 'Every / all / only / exactly-one' criteria require the whole collection, and 'unchanged' guards don't punish legit side-effects. Reports every instance.
quality_review.evidence: Both Members/staff roles, full ballot/audit snapshots, all choice totals and both restarts are checked; hidden totals wait for publication.

quality_review.rubric: Each criterion is a concrete, browser-observable outcome with durable evidence and distinctive probes. Reports every instance.
quality_review.evidence: Assertions use visible UI or observed same-origin responses. Restart uses only a trusted process helper, never SQLite inspection.

quality_review.rubric: Each criterion states ONE full-credit bar - it doesn't enumerate several things then waive most, leaving the judge two targets. Reports every instance.
quality_review.evidence: Reviewed all descriptions for one full-credit bar; optional single-choice percentages are clearly distinguished from required counts.

quality_review.rubric: If interactive/animated/responsive/themed, the judges actually click, wait, resize, or toggle - not score a still first paint.
quality_review.evidence: Browser regression changes viewport/theme/reduced-motion and keyboard focus; prompts require real interaction.

quality_review.rubric: At least one criterion proves the defining behavior works, and (where stateful) state survives reload/re-auth and is server-backed where required.
quality_review.evidence: Exact vote totals and real two-process restarts prove downstream durability, sessions and replay receipts.

quality_review.rubric: Distinctive values the judge creates to prove a mutation aren't already in the seed or the reference's initial state.
quality_review.evidence: Distinctive created titles/context are absent from seed and initial reference data.

quality_review.rubric: A later dimension doesn't assume a pristine seed after an earlier dimension mutated the shared running app.
quality_review.evidence: Polish accepts current mutated records and can publish an approval result if the earlier workflow did not.

quality_review.rubric: Batched dimension prompts tell the judge to score each criterion on its own and continue after a failure (one miss can't zero the rest).
quality_review.evidence: Prompts say continue after independent failures; no blanket failure propagation from a related probe.

quality_review.rubric: A blank / static / mock / seed-copy / keyword-stuffed / refusing submission scores near zero across the rubric.
quality_review.evidence: All-dimension auth/backend gate targets mocks; missing-entrypoint runner returns zero. New full no-op/LLM floor calibration remains platform work.

quality_review.rubric: The rubric produces a spread across partial-quality apps, not all-or-nothing.
quality_review.evidence: Functional 60% plus Polish 40%, gated by Render/Constraints; local score composition tested with partial dimension inputs.

quality_review.rubric: Pass/fail behaviors are binary; craft and degree-of-quality are likert with described anchors.
quality_review.evidence: Behavioral checks are binary; visual hierarchy has 1/3/5 Likert anchors and intermediate values.

quality_review.rubric: A worse app never outscores a better one - weights/gates/criteria don't invert the ranking.
quality_review.evidence: Nonnegative weights and strict gates preserve rubric monotonicity; empirical LLM ranking still needs platform runs.

quality_review.rubric: Gate/constraint failures hard-zero the quality terms, and passing only the cheap gates earns little.
quality_review.evidence: Any render/constraints score below 1 zeros final reward; gates carry no positive reward mass.

quality_review.rubric: Weight tracks what each thing proves - real functionality is weighted above structure and style.
quality_review.evidence: Functional has higher overall weight than Polish; no weights were increased to manufacture a lower model score.

quality_review.rubric: Every dimension prompt treats the submission as untrusted and forbids following instructions embedded in it.
quality_review.evidence: Every prompt labels submitted text/network/source untrusted and rejects scoring directions; browsing limited to task evidence.

quality_review.rubric: The agent can't read the criteria it's graded on or influence the reward - grading is isolated in the verifier.
quality_review.evidence: Separate verifier; app launched as UID65534 with explicit environment. Local test confirms tests/config/score dir unreadable by app UID.

quality_review.rubric: Pinned model, temperature 0, versioned prompt, pinned browser, and no unpinned network in the scoring path.
quality_review.evidence: Pinned images/model/tool versions and prompt markers reduce drift; an external LLM is not deterministic. Public-network policy and fresh calibration remain review caveats.

quality_review.rubric: Every dimension prompt describes THIS app (credentials, screens, entities, deliverable) with no residue from other work. Reports every instance.
quality_review.evidence: App names, accounts and expected results agree; no spreadsheet or other-task residue found in prompts.

quality_review.rubric: Every runtime fact appearing in more than one file (paths, port, seed, accounts, model, weights, literals) agrees everywhere. Reports every drift.
quality_review.evidence: Versions, accounts, port, seed, runtime packages, routes and score weights checked across files.

quality_review.rubric: The directory is the closed list - no scratch, build residue, committed caches, or backups, and all required files present.
quality_review.evidence: Only task inputs, instructions, solution and tests are packaged; all local reports/screenshots/helpers stay outside.

quality_review.rubric: The gating files are well-formed: both TOML families, the shell scripts (bash -n, no CRLF), and the reference/app entry.
quality_review.evidence: TOML/JSON/Python/JavaScript/shell parse; both images built and local execution completed.

quality_review.rubric: No live credentials, real personal data, host paths, unpinned remote fetch, or injection payload anywhere in the task.
quality_review.evidence: Only synthetic demo accounts and provider placeholders. No live keys or private host paths in upload files.

quality_review.rubric: The task reads as authored for this product, fits the suite's domain plan, and isn't a nouns-swapped clone of a sibling.
quality_review.evidence: Private membership ballots with eligibility snapshots and anonymous results form a distinct product, not renamed spreadsheet/editor code.
